preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 300000 for n in [int(stdin.split()[0])]) and all(n - 1 <= m <= 300000 for m in [int(stdin.split()[1])])
preconditions.description: Input must have n vertices (1 ≤ n ≤ 3·10^5) and m edges (n-1 ≤ m ≤ 3·10^5), where the graph is connected.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= int(d) <= 1 for d in stdin.split()[2:2+n])
preconditions.description: Each vertex degree constraint di must satisfy -1 ≤ di ≤ 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(u) <= n and 1 <= int(v) <= n for u, v in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[3:]))
preconditions.description: Each edge (u, v) must have 1 ≤ u, v ≤ n, and no self-loops (u ≠ v).
Input must have exactly n + m + 2 lines (1 for n,m, 1 for d, and m for edges).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(1 <= int(e) <= m for e in (line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])))
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output is exactly '-1'. Otherwise, the first line is k (number of edges in subset), followed by k lines of edge indices (1 ≤ e ≤ m).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (stdout.strip() != '-1' and (lambda: (lambda edges_subset: all((lambda i: (lambda deg: (di == -1 or deg % 2 == di))(sum(1 for e in edges_subset if (i in e or (e[0] == i and e[1] != i) or (e[1] == i and e[0] != i)))) for i in range(1, n+1)))(set(tuple(sorted((int(u), int(v))) for u, v in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[3:][int(e)-1:int(e)]))))))())
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', the selected subset of edges must satisfy: for every vertex i, di = -1 or its degree modulo 2 equals di in the subgraph formed by the subset.
